sloka: ततस्तु लक्ष्ये स विहन्यमाने शरेष्वमोघेषु च संपतत्सु ।जागम चिन्तां महतीं महात्मा समाधिसंयोगसमाहितात्मा ।। ५.४८.३५।।।।
transliteration: tatastu lakṣye sa vihanyamāne śareṣvamogheṣu ca saṁpatatsu ।jāgama cintāṁ mahatīṁ mahātmā samādhisaṁyogasamāhitātmā ।। 5.48.35।।।।

translations.english: Then Indrajit, son of the demon king, thinking that a vanara should not be killed started considering other means of catching hm.
